line.name: Perdomo Two Guys Smoke Shop 40th Anniversary
line.description: A retailer-exclusive limited edition released August 4, 2025 to commemorate the retailer Two Guys Smoke Shop's 40th anniversary - NOT a Perdomo-company anniversary release. Limited to 400 ten-count boxes. Flagging clearly since this is a one-off retailer exclusive rather than a standing catalog line - your call whether this belongs in a general product database.
line.limited_edition_notes: 400 ten-count boxes, retailer-exclusive to Two Guys Smoke Shop.
